typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_DATETIME as string,
		ORDER_ID as string,
		COUNTERPARTY_ID as string,
		COUNTERPARTY_ACCOUNT_CODE as string,
		SALESPERSON as string,
		BUY_SELL as string,
		ALLOCATION_QUANTITY as float,
		INSTRUMENT_CODE as string,
		GROSS_PRICE as float,
		EXCHANGE_ID as string,
		COMMISSION as float,
		TRADE_ID as string,
		ALLOCATION_ID as string,
		ALLOCATION_VERSION as string,
		STEP_OUT as string,
		SEND_TO as string,
		REPORT_TO_ACT as string,
		MARKUP as string,
		SALESCREDIT as string,
		COMMISSION_INDICATOR as string,
		CREDIT_BREAKDOWN as string,
		CUSTOMER_FUND_ID as string,
		ISIN_CODE as string,
		DEALT_CURRENCY as string,
		SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY as string,
		BUY_SELL_QUALIFIER as string,
		STATUS as string,
		INSTRUMENT_ID as string,
		EXPORTABLE_INDICATOR as string,
		STEPOUT_ACRONYM as string,
		INSTRUMENT_TYPE as string,
		UNDERLYING_INSTRUMENT_FIM_CODE as string,
		EXPIRY_DATE as string,
		OPTION_TYPE as string,
		STRIKE_PRICE as string,
		EXERCISE_TYPE as string,
		STATUS_CHANGE_TIMESTAMP as string,
		COUNTERPARTY_VIEW_CODE as string,
		NET_NET_CONSIDERATION as string,
		VALUE_DATE as string,
		TRADING_ENTITY_ID as string,
		FOLIO_PREFIX as string,
		FOLIO_NUMBER as string,
		FOLIO_DATETIME as string,
		SUB_FOLIO_NUMBER as string,
		ETC_SERVICE as string,
		BOI_CODE as string,
		RESEARCH_FEE as string,
		BROKER_OF_CREDIT as string,
		STEP_IN as string,
		STEPPED_OUT_FROM_MPID as string,
		STEPPED_OUT_FROM_CLEARING_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FileName = toString(($sFileName))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of FileName} = FileName) ~> DataConversion
DerivedColumn aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion sink(input(
		STRIKE_PRICE as string,
		COUNTERPARTY_VIEW_CODE as string,
		FOLIO_PREFIX as string,
		STEPPED_OUT_FROM_MPID as string,
		TRADING_ENTITY_ID as string,
		EXCHANGE_ID as string,
		SALESCREDIT as string,
		REPORT_TO_ACT as string,
		ETC_SERVICE as string,
		STATUS as string,
		STEP_IN as string,
		SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY as string,
		ALLOCATION_ID as string,
		TRADE_ID as string,
		BUY_SELL_QUALIFIER as string,
		INSTRUMENT_TYPE as string,
		DEALT_CURRENCY as string,
		UNDERLYING_INSTRUMENT_FIM_CODE as string,
		SALESPERSON as string,
		GROSS_PRICE as float,
		VALUE_DATE as string,
		STATUS_CHANGE_TIMESTAMP as string,
		INSTRUMENT_ID as string,
		EXERCISE_TYPE as string,
		EXPORTABLE_INDICATOR as string,
		BOI_CODE as string,
		MARKUP as string,
		SUB_FOLIO_NUMBER as string,
		ALLOCATION_QUANTITY as float,
		CREDIT_BREAKDOWN as string,
		FileName as string,
		COMMISSION_INDICATOR as string,
		BUY_SELL as string,
		EXPIRY_DATE as string,
		TRADE_DATETIME as string,
		CUSTOMER_FUND_ID as string,
		BROKER_OF_CREDIT as string,
		STEPPED_OUT_FROM_CLEARING_CODE as string,
		FOLIO_DATETIME as string,
		COUNTERPARTY_ID as string,
		SEND_TO as string,
		COUNTERPARTY_ACCOUNT_CODE as string,
		STEP_OUT as string,
		STEPOUT_ACRONYM as string,
		RESEARCH_FEE as string,
		INSTRUMENT_CODE as string,
		FOLIO_NUMBER as string,
		COMMISSION as float,
		NET_NET_CONSIDERATION as float,
		ORDER_ID as string,
		ALLOCATION_VERSION as string,
		ISIN_CODE as string,
		OPTION_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		STRIKE_PRICE,
		COUNTERPARTY_VIEW_CODE,
		FOLIO_PREFIX,
		STEPPED_OUT_FROM_MPID,
		TRADING_ENTITY_ID,
		EXCHANGE_ID,
		SALESCREDIT,
		REPORT_TO_ACT,
		ETC_SERVICE,
		STATUS,
		STEP_IN,
		SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY,
		ALLOCATION_ID,
		TRADE_ID,
		BUY_SELL_QUALIFIER,
		INSTRUMENT_TYPE,
		DEALT_CURRENCY,
		UNDERLYING_INSTRUMENT_FIM_CODE,
		SALESPERSON,
		GROSS_PRICE,
		VALUE_DATE,
		STATUS_CHANGE_TIMESTAMP,
		INSTRUMENT_ID,
		EXERCISE_TYPE,
		EXPORTABLE_INDICATOR,
		BOI_CODE,
		MARKUP,
		SUB_FOLIO_NUMBER,
		ALLOCATION_QUANTITY,
		CREDIT_BREAKDOWN,
		FileName = {Copy of FileName},
		COMMISSION_INDICATOR,
		BUY_SELL,
		EXPIRY_DATE,
		TRADE_DATETIME,
		CUSTOMER_FUND_ID,
		BROKER_OF_CREDIT,
		STEPPED_OUT_FROM_CLEARING_CODE,
		FOLIO_DATETIME,
		COUNTERPARTY_ID,
		SEND_TO,
		COUNTERPARTY_ACCOUNT_CODE,
		STEP_OUT,
		STEPOUT_ACRONYM,
		RESEARCH_FEE,
		INSTRUMENT_CODE,
		FOLIO_NUMBER,
		COMMISSION,
		NET_NET_CONSIDERATION,
		ORDER_ID,
		ALLOCATION_VERSION,
		ISIN_CODE,
		OPTION_TYPE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
